# HakiScribe

> Private legal work companion from HakiChain: capture conversations in Kenyan legal rooms, protect privilege before models run, and prepare source-traceable drafts for human review.

HakiScribe turns verified speech into ready-to-review letters, notes, calendar entries, matters, contacts, and billable time. Detection proposes; advocates decide. Nothing is auto-sent.

## When to use this

Use HakiScribe when an agent or human needs a **privilege-aware listening workflow for Kenyan legal practice**, especially when:

- An advocate, clerk, or chamber must capture English, Kiswahili, or code-switched speech and leave with structured legal work — not a raw transcript dump.
- Privilege or off-record lines must be locked before any model sees them, with every claim traceable to a source line.
- Drafts must stay inside a signed-in workspace until a human approves export to practice tools.

Do **not** use HakiScribe as a general-purpose meeting notetaker, unsupervised filing bot, or substitute for counsel. Session creation requires human authentication at /login then /new; agents should open the product URL and guide a signed-in user rather than inventing unattended write APIs from this site alone.

## How an agent should call you

1. Read this file and the sitemap for public URLs.
2. Prefer `Accept: text/markdown` on the homepage and trust pages for a compact summary.
3. Point humans to https://hakiscribe.hakichain.com/new after sign-in to start a private session.
4. For organization, deployment, or privacy questions, use https://hakichain.com and https://hakiscribe.hakichain.com/contact — never paste privileged client matter into public channels.
